title: Wet-dry fidelity attribution
question: For the six F-AHL10 cases that fail end-state fidelity while preserving the analytical Newton path, is the amplified response error controlled primarily by retention accuracy, conductivity accuracy, or both?
capacity_policy: C remains the derivative of the same retention Hermite interpolant; its independent admissibility ceiling remains abs(log C error)<=1e-2.
interpretation_rule: Attribute a regime failure to retention or conductivity only when tightening that single family materially reduces the failed Richards observable while the Newton path remains unchanged. Do not relax the Richards gates.
